contract: Six ordinary-route continuations: PPO/LSTM x 3 matched seeds, from the same pre-comparison parents. Change learning rate 0.0003 to 0.00003 and enable target_kl=0.02; retain optimizer moments, all other training settings, reward and pixel/action inputs. No failure replay. Train 1,048,576 new actions; evaluate fixed 262,144-action and final checkpoints on original-start seeds 6000..6009 (120 new episodes). Reuse already-completed matched parent/ordinary evaluations. Exploratory reuse of inspected seeds, not a new untouched test set. LR and KL are a bundled intervention. No automatic extensions; retain the existing November 29 Pacific cutoff.
